# AG Water Softener

> AG is a $249 water softener built for renters in apartments and condos. It installs without plumbing changes and softens water at the shower. Sold by GRN Labs. Single product, ships in the US.

Key facts: uses ion exchange to remove hardness minerals, sized for a single bathroom, no landlord permission needed, MPN AG-WS-001.

## Guides

- [Shower filter vs water softener: which one fixes your water](https://agsoftener.com/shower-filter-vs-water-softener): Shower filters remove chlorine. Water softeners remove calcium and magnesium. Here is how to tell which problem you have and which device fixes it.
- [Do shower filters work for hard water?](https://agsoftener.com/do-shower-filters-work-for-hard-water): Shower filters remove chlorine, not hardness. Calcium and magnesium pass straight through carbon and KDF. Here is what removes them instead.
- [Water softener for an apartment: what actually works](https://agsoftener.com/water-softener-for-apartment): You can't install a whole-house softener in an apartment or condo. A shower-mounted ion-exchange softener is the option that actually softens water.
- [Portable water softener for your shower: the real options](https://agsoftener.com/portable-water-softener-for-shower): RV softeners work but weigh 30 pounds and sit on your floor. Here is what a portable water softener built for a shower looks like, and what it costs.
- [Shower head water softener: most of them can't soften water](https://agsoftener.com/shower-head-water-softener): Most products sold as shower head water softeners are chlorine filters. Here is how to read a listing and what removes hardness for real.
